_note: Play Options Menu, table L1973-L2047. The brief names region 'L1990-L2060' and expects rounds/sudden-death there: 'Rounds 1-1000 default 10' actually lives in the Main Menu at L1616, and 'sudden death' appears NOWHERE in the manual — both are recorded below (rounds with its true anchor; sudden death as missing, not invented).

mapSize.label: Map Size
mapSize.description: Battlefield size. Default is the classic field; medium scales both world axes x2.5, large x5. Turn budget and the aquarium panes scale with the map.

mode.label: Mode
mode.description: Sequential: turns one after another. Simultaneous: everyone aims and fires at once. Synchronous: all aim at round start, all shots fire together.
mode.storage_reason: Manual Seq/Sync/Simul row — W4-A implemented turn modes as the turnMode row (main.js TURN_MODES); this legacy descriptor persists verbatim, no consumer of its own.

teams.label: Teams
teams.description: Team play (several tanks ganging up on others).
teams.storage_reason: Consumed via the teamLayout row (W4-A stores it as se.settings.teams); this legacy duplicate descriptor has no consumer of its own.

turnMode.label: Turn Mode
turnMode.description: synchronous: tanks alternate turns (classic). simultaneous: lockstep planning — every alive tank commits one shot, then all shots resolve together in one flight phase. _source: plan SE-COMPLETE-1012 W4-A; manual:L2164-L2212 (Simultaneous), L2214-L2228 (Synchronous).

teamLayout.label: Team Layout
teamLayout.description: Team play: friendly fire between teammates is OFF, and a round ends when the last TEAM stands. 2V2 and 1V2V1 need exactly 4 players. (The manual's classic NONE/STANDARD/CORPORATE/VICIOUS Teams enum above stays the archive option; this build implements the concrete layouts.)
teamLayout._note: Plan SE-COMPLETE-1012 W4-A: concrete layouts per the brief (2v2 / 1v2v1); Being a Team Player manual:L2233-L2255.

friendlyFire.label: Friendly Fire
friendlyFire.description: When ON, damage applies between teammates (and to self). When OFF (default), friendly fire is zeroed at the damage gate.
friendlyFire._source: plan SE-FIXUP-1012 contract C1 (task-directed, no manual row)
friendlyFire._note: Stored TYPED boolean se.settings.friendlyFire by applySettings (on/off enum -> boolean, same law as tanksFall). Consumer (W9, contract C4) gates at the DAMAGE application site reading window.__se.settings.friendlyFire.

statusBar.label: Status Bar
statusBar.description: Second bar under the normal one giving most Tank Control Panel functions.
statusBar.storage_reason: Second control bar deferred — the existing top-panel HUD carries the status readout (plan 1.7 audit note); storage + validation only.

playOrder.label: Play Order
playOrder.description: RANDOM: order each turn. LOSERS-FIRST/WINNERS-FIRST: rank-based. ROUND-ROBIN: random turns, but first shot rotates per round.
playOrder.storage_reason: Director consumes the battle turnOrder array (makeDirector turnOrder param, main.js); the RANDOM/LOSERS-FIRST/WINNERS-FIRST schemes are not consulted yet (W4-A shipped turn modes only).

fastComputers.label: Fast Computers
fastComputers.description: Speeds up the game while only computers are fighting.
fastComputers.storage_reason: AI speed-up not implemented — storage + validation only.

talkingTanks.label: Talking Tanks
talkingTanks.description: Tanks flash comic-style messages: computers only, or everyone.
talkingTanks.storage_reason: systems/talk.js plays taunts unconditionally from data/talk.json (W4-C); the on/off gate is not consulted.

talkProbability.label: Talk Probability
talkProbability.description: How often tanks say something before firing.
talkProbability.storage_reason: Talk plays are ungated (data/talk.json cooldown rules only); the probability roll is not consulted.

attackFile.label: Attack file
attackFile.description: ASCII file of messages tanks say when attacking.
attackFile.storage_reason: Legacy .cfg passthrough (S1 config renderer only); taunt lines ship as data/talk.json (W4-C) — file overrides are not loaded.

dieFile.label: Die file
dieFile.description: ASCII file of messages tanks say when they die.
dieFile.storage_reason: Legacy .cfg passthrough (S1 config renderer only); taunt lines ship as data/talk.json (W4-C) — file overrides are not loaded.

mainMenuGameplay._note: Game-length knobs the brief expected inside Play Options but which live in the Main Menu.

suddenDeath._note: No 'sudden death' option exists anywhere in the 1.5 manual (searched); the brief's mention is untranscribable — reported, not invented.
suddenDeath.storage_reason: Declared-absent marker row: no Sudden Death option exists in the 1.5 manual (searched; _note) — presence:false keeps the omission visible in data (doctrine: documented omission).

count.description: Players in the battle. Drives the setup roster rows and the battle's tank bindings.

players._spawnRadiusSource: plan SE-COMPLETE-1012 W1.5 (user brief 2026-10-11): each player's spawn anchor randomizes within this radius (effective radius capped at half the min anchor separation so zones never cross).
